name: InlineEdit
summary: A value shown as text that turns into an Input to edit in place, with save and cancel, such as a board name in its header.
useWhen: A short value the person renames now and then where it is shown: a board, a file, a layer, a column
A title in a header that should read as text, not as a form field
One value in a list of items, each renamed on its own
avoidWhen: A form with several fields saved together
A value the person must fill in to go on

label.description: Required. The name of what is edited: the editor's name, and part of the display's name.

value.description: The value, controlled. Pair it with onValueChange.

onValueChange.description: Called with the new value when it is saved, and only when it changed.

defaultEditing.description: Opens in the editor, for a new item named right away. Focus moves only when editing starts later, never on the first render.

onEditingChange.description: Called with true when editing starts and false when it ends.

validate.description: Returns a message that says how to fix the value, or nothing. An invalid value is never saved, on Enter, on save or on leaving the editor.

placeholder.description: Shown in the display while the value is empty.

editLabel.description: The display's name after the value. Default Edit plus the label in lower case. Pass it in Arabic.

savedLabel.description: Said once by a polite status after a save.

size.description: Height from size.control, for the display and the editor. The save and cancel buttons are xs, and sm at lg.

disabled.description: The display cannot start editing; it keeps aria-disabled and stays focusable.

invalid.description: Marks the value invalid from outside, for example after a server check.

inputRef.description: Goes to the native input while editing. ref goes to the root.

a11y.role: button for the display (a ghost Button), textbox for the editor, buttons for save and cancel, status for the saved message
a11y.focus: Viewing, the display is one tab stop. Editing starts with focus in the input and its text selected; Tab moves to save, then cancel. Enter, Escape, save and cancel return focus to the display. Leaving the editor with Tab or a click saves a valid value and leaves focus where it went.

keys.Tab: Moves focus to the display; while editing, from the input to save and cancel
keys.Enter: On the display: starts editing. In the input: saves and returns focus to the display; an invalid value keeps the editor open with its message
keys.Escape: In the input: drops the change and returns focus to the display. It stops there, so a dialog around it stays open

a11y.announce: The display is named by the value and the edit label: Spring launch, Edit board name. The input is named by label. After a save, a polite status says Saved once; a failed save says the message once, which also joins the input's aria-describedby.
notes: The display name starts with the visible text, so voice control works (WCAG 2.5.3).
The save and cancel buttons keep focus in the input on press, so a press never reads as leaving the editor.
The message is an icon plus text, never color alone, and says how to fix the value.
The edit icon at the end of the display shows on hover and focus; the name says edit at all times.

en.label: A noun for what is edited, in sentence case: Board name.
en.placeholder: Add plus the noun: Add a board name.
en.error: Say how to fix it: Add a name of at least 1 letter.

react.behavior: hand built on Button, Input and IconButton
react.note: Motion: the edit icon fades in on hover and focus, and the Input focus glow fades in. The swap between viewing and editing is instant.

styles.studio: The value as ghost button text with the Input's inset, so the text does not move when the editor opens.
styles.desk: The same, in Instrument Sans; the editor is the Desk pill.
styles.neutral: Takes the tokens of the Neutral style, no recipe.

mistakes.wrong: Saving on blur whatever was typed
mistakes.right: validate, so an invalid value keeps the editor open with its message

mistakes.wrong: A span with an onClick that turns into an input
mistakes.right: InlineEdit, whose display is a real button with a name that says edit

mistakes.wrong: Announcing Saved on every key or on every render
mistakes.right: One polite status after a save

mistakes.wrong: InlineEdit for a field the person must fill to submit a form
